description:
All of YouTube Music with no ads, plus 3D covers, lossless downloads and lyrics in time.

Verza plays all of YouTube Music, full length, with no ads.

Album covers move in 3D as you move the pointer. Download songs, in lossless if you like,
and follow lyrics line by line. Home and mixes are built from what you play. A ten-band
equalizer, crossfade, a sleep timer and media keys are included.

Verza is independent and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
